question: WHAT IS THIS
SYSTEM CALLED?
recap: A tank racing over rough ground while its barrel stays locked on the target.
explain: Gyroscopic sensors measure every pitch and roll of the hull.
Hydraulic or electric drives instantly move the turret and barrel the opposite way, so the aim never drifts.
The first production tank with one was the American M3 Lee in World War Two. Modern tanks hold their aim in both directions and can fire accurately on the move.
